The '''European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology''' ('''ESMTB''') is a non-profit academic society designed to bring together mathematicians and biologists interested in the use of mathematical and theoretical techniques for the solution of biological and medical problems. It was founded in 1991 during the holding of its first conference in [[Alpe d'Huez]], France. It is a member society of the [[European Mathematical Society]] (EMS) and the [[International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (ICIAM). The society's official journal is the ''[[Journal of Mathematical Biology]]''.

== History ==
=== Origins ===
The European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology was founded in 1991 at its first conference, entitled ''European Conference on Mathematics Applied to Biology and Medicine'', held in Alpe d'Huez.<ref name="Alt2006">{{cite journal |last1=Alt |first1=Wolfgang |title=ESMTB – European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |journal=Journal of Mathematical Biology |date=2006 |volume=53 |issue=3 |pages=337–339 |doi=10.1007/s00285-006-0030-1}}</ref> The mention of medicine in the title of this conference was relevant because much of the applied mathematics researched by members has related to medical topics. The founding President, [[James D. Murray|James Murray]] developed models of wound healing<ref name="Sherratt_etal1992">{{Cite journal |last1=Sherratt |first1=Jonathan A. |last2=Martin |first2=Paul |last3=Murray |first3=J. D. |author3-link=James D. Murray |last4=Lewis |first4=Julian |title=Mathematical models of wound healing in embryonic and adult epidermis |journal=Mathematical Medicine and Biology |date=1992 |volume=9 |issue=3 |pages=177–196 |doi=10.1093/imammb/9.3.177 |pmid=1295928 }}</ref> as well as applying mathematics to many other areas of medicine and biology.<ref name="Maini_etal2022">{{cite journal |last1=Maini |first1=Philip K. |author1-link=Philip Maini |last2=Chaplain |first2=Mark A. J. |author2-link=Mark Chaplain |last3=Lewis |first3=Mark A. |last4=Sherratt |first4=Jonathan A. |title=Special Collection: Celebrating J.D. Murray's Contributions to Mathematical Biology |journal=Bulletin of Mathematical Biology |date=2022 |volume=84 |issue=1 |article-number=13 |doi=10.1007/s11538-021-00955-8 |pmid=34865189 }}</ref> Andrea De Gaetano is a qualified physician and has published many papers on applied mathematics in medicine.<ref name="De Gaetano" /> Ellen Baake has worked on mathematical immunobiology.<ref name="Baake_Bielfeld">{{cite web |title=Professorin Ellen Baake koordiniert neuen DFG-Schwerpunkt |url=https://idw-online.de/en/news41943 |publisher=Bielefeld University |access-date=13 July 2026 |language=German |trans-title=Professor Ellen Baake coordinates new DFG focus}}</ref>

== Activities ==

=== Aims ===
The aims of the Society are to promote the application of mathematical and theoretical solutions to biological{{efn|Where "biological" is understood to also include "medical" given the activity in the field.}} problems through organisation of meetings, support of publications, and benefits to members.{{efn|Members gain acccess to the Society's publications and discounts to meetings.}} The aims of the Society also involve collaborations with other organisations in the same and related fields.<ref name="Deutsch2006">{{cite journal |last1=Deutsch |first1=Andreas |title=ESMTB-European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |journal=Journal of Mathematical Biology |date=2006 |volume=53 |issue=5 |pages=887–888 |doi=10.1007/s00285-006-0041-y}}</ref>

=== Affiliations and Partnerships ===
The academic credibility of the European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology has been established through its affiliations and partnerships. The ESMTB is an Associate Member of the European Mathematical Society.<ref name="EMS">{{cite web |title=Corporate Members of the EMS: Associate |url=https://euromathsoc.org/corporate-members/associate |publisher=European Mathematical Society |access-date=5 July 2026}}</ref> It is an affiliated Member of the International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics.<ref name="ICIAM">{{cite web |title=ICIAM: Members |url=https://iciam.org/membership/members |publisher=International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics |access-date=5 July 2026}}</ref> The ESMTB has partnerships with the [[Society for Mathematical Biology]], the Japanese Society for Mathematical Biology,<ref name="JSMB">{{cite web |title=JSMB Homepage |url=https://jsmb.jp/welcome-to-the-japanese-society-for-mathematical-biology-home-page/ |publisher=Japanese Society for Mathematical Biology |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> the NVTB (Dutch Society for Theoretical Biology)<ref name="NVTB">{{cite web |title=NVTB - Dutch society for theoretical biology |url=https://theoreticalbiology.nl/ |publisher=NVTB |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> and the SFTB (Société Francophone de Biologie Théorique).<ref name="SFBT">{{cite web |title=Société Francophone de Biologie Théorique |url=https://sfbt.math.cnrs.fr/index.html |publisher=SFBT |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> Existing members of these organisations get discounts when applying for membership.<ref name="ESMTB_Membership">{{cite web |title=Membership Application |url=https://esmtb.org/Application |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> The partnership with the Society for Mathematical Biology is particularly relevant, as the Society for Mathematical Biology states on its website: "The Society has agreed to hold a joint annual meeting with the European Society for Mathematical & Theoretical Biology every four years".<ref name="Joint_SMB_ESMTB_Meetings">{{cite web |title=Annual SMB Meetings |url=https://www.smb.org/Annual-SMB-Meetings |publisher=Society for Mathematical Biology |access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref> The 2026 European Conference on Mathematical & Theoretical Biology was a joint event of ESMTB and the Society for Mathematical Biology.<ref name="ECMTB2026">{{cite web |title=14th European Conference on Mathematical & Theoretical Biology |url=https://ecmtb2026.org/ |publisher=University of Graz |access-date=8 July 2026}}</ref>

=== Publications ===
The [[peer review|peer reviewed]] ''[[Journal of Mathematical Biology]]'' is the official journal of the Society.<ref name="JMB">{{cite web |title=Journal of Mathematical Biology |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/285 |publisher=Springer Nature Link |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> The ESMTB also publishes the ''European Communications in Mathematical and Theoretical Biology'' annually to its members.<ref name="EurCommsMTB">{{cite web |title=European Communications in Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |url=https://esmtb.org/ESMTB-Communications |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> Members of the Society also receive the monthly ''ESMTB Newsletter''.<ref name="ESMTB_Newsletter">{{cite web |title=The monthly ESMTB newsletter |url=https://esmtb.org/Newsletters |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref> Under the title ''Perspectives in Mathematical Biology'' the ESMTB also invited short contributions on mathematical and theoretical biology that were published in the ''Journal of Mathematical Biology'' between 2006<ref name="Alt2006" /> and 2020.<ref name="Feliu2020">{{cite journal |last1=Feliu |first1=Elisenda |title=On the role of algebra in models in molecular biology |journal=Journal of Mathematical Biology |date=2020 |volume=80 |issue=4 |pages=1159–1161 |doi=10.1007/s00285-019-01456-y |pmid=31832753 |url=https://researchprofiles.ku.dk/da/publications/7548b083-113a-483d-b7f7-c1e7cc9f921c }}</ref> Since 2020 these contributions have been discontinued.<ref name="Pers_MathBiol">{{cite web |title=Perspectives in Mathematical Biology |url=https://esmtb.org/Perspectives |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Thereotical Biology |access-date=6 July 2026}}</ref>

=== Meetings ===
The ESMTB holds [[wikt:biennial|biennial]] conferences.<ref>{{cite web |title=13TH EDITION OF THE EUROPEAN CONFERENCE ON MATHEMATICAL AND THEORETICAL BIOLOGY |url=https://esmtb.org/resources/Documents/ECMTB_2024.pdf |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |access-date=13 July 2026}}</ref> It also supports online colloqia,<ref name="Méléard2026">{{cite web |last1=Méléard |first1=Sylvie |title=From individual-based models to free-boundary Hamilton-Jacobi equations |date=2026 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UXmXfr16smA |publisher=YouTube |access-date=13 July 2026}}</ref> and summer schools (in conjunction with the European Mathematical Society).<ref name="ESMTB-EMS DSIN Summer School 2017">{{cite web |title=ESMTB-EMS & DSIN Summerschool Mathematical Neuroscience June 26-30th 2017 |url=https://web.math.ku.dk/~susanne/web/index.html |publisher=University of Copenhagen |access-date=13 July 2026}}</ref>

=== Prizes ===

==== Reinardt Heinrich Award ====
The Society awards an annual [[Reinhardt Heinrich]] Doctoral Thesis Award in memory of Reinhardt Heinrich,<ref name="InRemebrance_Heinrich2007">{{cite journal |last1=Höfer |first1=Thomas |title=In Remembrance: Reinhart Heinrich 1946–2006 |journal=PLOS Computational Biology |date=2007 |volume=3 |pages=e18 |doi=10.1371/journal.pcbi.0030018 |doi-access=free |pmc=1782044 }}</ref> to recognise outstanding doctoral thesis research, and to commemorate the role of Heinrich in mentoring young scientists.<ref name="RH Doctoral Thesis Award">{{cite web |title=Reinhart-Heinrich Doctoral Thesis Award |url=https://esmtb.org/Reinhart-Heinrich-Award |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |access-date=15 July 2026}}</ref> Recent recipients of the award are shown in the table below.

==== Karl-Peter Hadeler Prize====
The Society's official journal, the Journal of Mathematical Biology, awards the Karl-Peter Hadeler Prize to recognise outstanding publications in that journal.<ref name="KPHadelerPrize">{{cite web |title=The Karl-Peter Hadeler Prize |url=https://link.springer.com/collections/cecjiifaha |publisher=Springer Nature Link |access-date=15 July 2026}}</ref> Karl-Peter Hadeler was both a founder of the Journal of Mathematical Biology and of the European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology.<ref name="KPHadelerPrize" />

==== Ovide Arino Award====
In collaboration with the Société Francophone de Biologie Théorique (SFBT) the ESMTB awards a prize to a researcher from a "Southern country"<ref>{{cite web |title=Ovide Arino Outreach Award (OAOA) |url=https://esmtb.org/Ovide-Arino-Award |publisher=European Society for Mathematical and Theoretical Biology |access-date=2 August 2026}}</ref> where "Southern" may be read as equivalent to [[developing  country]] although in fact there is a specific list of eligible countries.<ref name="OAOAeligible">{{cite web |title=OAOA_2023_eligible_countries.pdf |url=https://esmtb.org/resources/Documents/OAOA_2023_eligible_countries.pdf |publisher=European Society for Mathematical Biology |access-date=2 August 2026}}</ref> The successful candidate must have been carrying out research in an eligible country at the time of application, in collaboration with a European or other French-speaking country. The award commemorates the French mathematician Ovide Arino.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ovide Arino |url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Arino/ |website=MacTutor |publisher=University of St Andrews |access-date=2 August 2026}}</ref>
